en: A tinted historic postcard showing a central square with a large church or basilica complex featuring a tall clock tower with a steep spire and several smaller spires and red-tiled roofs. The foreground is an open plaza, and surrounding buildings include a house with arcades on the left and another with business signage on the right. The bottom margin contains printed greeting text in a Slavic language and the publisher's credit.
